items.title: Human trafficking victims stranded in Guinea-Bissau
items.summary: Dozens of West Africans lured to Guinea-Bissau with promises of jobs and migration to Europe say they were exploited by a suspected trafficking network. Now many cannot afford to return home This article contains descriptions of rape, exploitation and sexual assault. Reader discretion is advised Sadio Konimba had hoped for a better future. The 26-year-old had lost her husband and was left alone with her child in Bamako, the capital of Mali When an acquaintance told her about the possibility of reaching Europe via the West African nation of Guinea-Bissau , she decided to make the journey. She left her 6-year-old daughter behind with relatives for the time being Konimba says she was invited to the country's capital, Bissau, with the promise of work and better chances of eventually continuing on to Europe She was told the journey from Bamako to Bissau would cost between 100,000–125,000 CFA francs (roughly €150-€190, or $170-$210), which she paid.

items.title: Mozambique: High Commission of India in Maputo celebrates Defence Cooperation Day
items.summary: The event was attended by senior officers of Mozambique’s Army, Navy and Air Force as well as Mozambican military personnel who have attended professional courses and joint exercises in India. In addition, military attaches of various countries accredited to Mozambique and the members of Indian business community of Maputo were present at the function The event laid special emphasis on Alumni Connect and Supply of Defence Equipment. On this front, Association of India Mozambique Military Alumni (AIMMA) was launched and its members were felicitated by the senior dignitaries. A presentation highlighting the key capabilities of India’s defence industry was also made The High Commissioner of India to Mozambique. Mr Robert Shetkintong stated that defence cooperation has emerged to be one of the major pillars of the bilateral relations between India and Mozambique. The Indian Defence Adviser, Colonel Puneet Attri highlighted that the defence cooperation between the two nations is guided by the needs and priorities of Mozambique.

items.title: Careless dismissals give Australia route to series win
items.summary: The winner of the third Test will finish the series top of the International Cricket Council's Test rankings Third Test, Cape Town (day three of five) South Africa 329 & 140-4: Ackerman 62; Starc 2-29 Australia 429: Inglis 102; Harmer 4-104 Batters carelessly gifting wickets to Australia... we have been here before This time it was not England helping their opponents, although they will have taken note with a tour of South Africa to come this winter South Africa's attempt to fight back in the decisive third Test against Australia was hurt by two poor strokes on day three Having taken the last six Australian wickets for 99 runs in the morning despite Josh Inglis' second Test century, the Proteas began their second innings facing a deficit of exactly 100 They needed runs from their experienced opener and number three. Neither Aiden Markram nor David Bedingham could deliver By the end, even captain Temba Bavuma had been tempted into a wild swipe to fall for 35.

items.title: Alaska governor orders probe into Democratic campaign's alleged links to same-name candidate
items.summary: Republican Governor Mike Dunleavy said he was acting on claims in a news report The Republican governor of Alaska has ordered an investigation into an alleged "scheme" which led to two men named Dan Sullivan standing in the state's US Senate race Governor Mike Dunleavy said he was responding to a New York Times (NYT) story , external which said the team of Democratic candidate Mary Peltola worked with people who tried to recruit spoiler candidates in the Senate race The governor's post on X said he would investigate "whether this scheme violated Alaska's laws". He did not say which laws he had in mind Dan S Sullivan, the incumbent Republican senator running for re-election, and allies have accused the Democrats of trying to confuse voters. Peltola's team deny any wrongdoing "The Alaskans for Mary campaign has no involvement with either Sullivan campaign," the Peltola campaign said in a statement They say they did not encourage the second man , Dan J Sullivan , a retired teacher who lives in a remote fishing village, to stand.

items.title: Justice for Maya women in Guatemala, girls back in school in India, restored land in Mali: The UN has named its 2026 SDG Action Award winners
items.summary: Champions of indigenous women's rights in Guatemala, girls' education in India, and restored farmland in Mali all featured among the winners of UN's SDG Action Awards A legal aid group for Indigenous women in Guatemala , a movement of village mothers in rural India, and a Malian entrepreneur who restores farmland have won this year's UN SDG Action Awards The winners were announced at the ninth Heroes of Tomorrow awards ceremony in Rome , Italy, run by the UN SDG Action Campaign. They were chosen from more than 7,000 entries from 190 countries Nine finalists were shortlisted for three categories: resilience, creativity and changemaker The Resilience Award went to the Women's Justice Initiative. Many indigenous women in Guatemala face high rates of violence, poverty and discrimination, made worse by language barriers and a lack of access to information. The initiative helps women and girls get access to justice and lead change in their communities.

items.title: US sanctions Rwanda's defence ministry over DR Congo conflict
items.summary: Eastern DR Congo has been plagued by conflict with M23 recapturing Goma and then Bukavu in early 2025 The United States has imposed sanctions on Rwanda's defence ministry over its alleged support for the M23 rebel group in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, increasing pressure on Kigali to withdraw its troops and halt support for the rebels "Rwanda must halt its support for M23 and withdraw its troops from eastern DRC," US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said The sanctions come months after Rwanda and DR Congo signed a US-brokered peace agreement aimed at ending the conflict Fighting has continued in eastern DR Congo since early 2025, when M23 seized the cities of Goma and Bukavu. Rwanda denies backing M23 The US Treasury says Rwanda's defence ministry directed thousands of troops to fight alongside M23 in eastern DR Congo, providing weapons, equipment, logistics and training The M23 has seized mineral-rich areas, including gold-mining sites in South Kivu and Rubaya, a major coltan-producing area in North Kivu.
